mapper.select: SELECT e.*, u.username, u.avatar as avatar, u.gender, u.age FROM xiangqin_enrollment e LEFT JOIN user u ON e.user_id = u.uid WHERE e.activity_id = #{activityId} AND e.status != 3 AND ( IFNULL(e.payment_amount, 0) <= 0 OR e.payment_status = 1 ) ORDER BY e.create_time DESC

SELECT e.*, a.title as activity_title, a.cover_img as activity_cover, a.start_time as activity_start_time, a.address as activity_address FROM xiangqin_enrollment e LEFT JOIN xiangqin_activity a ON e.activity_id = a.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status != 3 AND ( IFNULL(e.payment_amount, 0) <= 0 OR e.payment_status = 1 ) ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
